qualification: Isolated Array length/property authority on the committed shared-VM baseline; unrelated pending host, function, TypedArray, Wasm and rooting changes excluded and preserved.

representation.length: own_array_length derives the existing dense/sparse owner length and excludes arguments objects. Ordinary own-property reads, LengthOfArrayLike, reflection and ArraySetLength use that operation. The separate property-read branch is removed.
representation.attributes: ARRAY_LENGTH_ATTRIBUTES owns the default exotic descriptor. Generic property attributes expose it when no explicit override exists. Reflection, integrity tests and definitions consume the same authority. The non-shape descriptor fallback domain is documented.
representation.write: Generic writes use the shared receiver Set before the existing ArraySetLength definition. A non-writable length rejects before coercion, including unchanged values; defining an unchanged value retains its separate coercion/descriptor contract.
representation.realm: Each realm Array.prototype is an array exotic cell. Length derives from its storage and default descriptor, replacing a second stored length value and attributes in realm installation.
representation.reduction: Removed the generic length-write shortcut, duplicate length reader and repeated storage/attribute derivation. No new side map or public API.

build.profile: release; correctness only, no performance claim

node_controls.scope: 20 sources in normal/generic modes plus four foreign-realm sources through the standard Test262 worker. Values, descriptors, own keys, receiver identity, coercion order, throws, partial shrink rollback and arguments-object exclusion. Node evaluates each source separately after installing print, preserving strict directives; Node vm contexts supply the realm oracle.

units: No duplicate Array/Object units added. Production suite inventories and matched Node observations qualify the semantic change.
limits: Staging Array is 90/90 at this candidate. The last complete staging selection at the baseline revision remains recorded separately; this affected selection does not qualify all staging cases.
Other conformance gaps, full Wasm and frozen implemented Node qualification, production legacy removal and Stage A remain open.
Pins, fixtures, harness, expectations, discovery and inventory membership are unchanged.
